title: Claude Code 2.1.261 — Prune skills wasting your context #Shorts
description:
Claude Code 2.1.261 adds /skill-doctor, a command that shows which loaded skills you never use and how much context they cost — so you can prune them.

Full release notes: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.261
